prompt: Stand somewhere in your own town you have never stood before and say out loud what you can hear. Thirty seconds; keep going after it gets boring.

rubric.ideal: I can hear traffic going past, a bus braking somewhere behind me, two people talking, and a fan humming out of a vent above my head.
I am standing on a corner at the far end of a street I have never been down, next to a wall and a row of parked cars.
This is not somewhere I ever come; I have driven past the end of this road but never stood on it.

prompt: Find a spot you have never taken a photo from and photograph what is in front of you. Not the sky, not your shoes; the actual view.

labels: a photo of a street seen from the end of it
a photo of an outdoor view over rooftops
a photo of a road stretching into the distance
a photo of a town seen from a high spot
negative_labels: a photo of the inside of a house
a photo of a person posing for a selfie
a photo of a computer screen
a photo of the sky with nothing in it
